purpose: identify AC2; licenses AC2's wording only

additivity.NOTE: both-bases is the reference and is 1.0 by construction; sum_of_singles > 1 means the two single-base destructions are sub-additive (saturating)

REFLECTION.identification: The nine-alt panel behind AC2's original wording contained only two of three cells: 'destroy both' and 'destroy G only'. Every alt that rewrote the T also destroyed the G, and z[1]=='T' held iff edit_size==1, so three readings were indistinguishable. GA/GG supply the 'destroy T only' cell and separate them.
could_not_have_failed: AC is the reference; its rho is 1.000 by construction and is not evidence
GC is excluded because it IS a non-canonical U2 donor -- 0% admissible under R44's own rule, not a power failure
REFLECTION.residual_confound: GA and GG are the only admissible T-only alts and both RETAIN the G at d. A 'destroy T, also destroy G' cell is by definition the both-bases arm, so retaining G is not separable from destroying T alone. GA and GG additionally sit on different admissibility sub-cohorts (37% vs 84%) and are reported separately for that reason; their agreement is the only cross-check available.
